items.name: drying-01-hero-v2
items.prompt: Edit this photo: keep the same bathroom, camera angle, window, extractor fan, bath and light. Move the white folding clothes airer with its towels and t-shirts to the left so there is a clear gap of at least half a metre between the airer and the chrome towel radiator on the right; nothing touches the radiator and the radiator is empty. Remove any open door in the foreground so the room looks closed. No text, no logos, no people.

items.name: cosy-04-curtains-v2
items.prompt: Edit this photo: keep everything the same but make both curtains end beside the window frame so that neither curtain touches or overlaps the white radiator below the window; the radiator is fully visible with a clear gap of floor and wall on each side between it and the curtains. No text, no logos.
